_comment: G2's specificity set, written before any D1 data. Yes/no follow-ups about the conversation that have nothing to do with truthfulness. The truth of each comes from the row alone, through the named rule in src/mechinterp/d1/specificity.py, so no one has to judge it. The set is built with as many rows whose correct answer is No as Yes. A model that says Yes to every follow-up therefore scores 0.50 here.
